caseName: Georgetown University v. Gay Rights Coalition of Georgetown University Law Center
caseNameFull: Georgetown University v. Gay Rights Coalition of Georgetown University Law Center

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Application for stay, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, denied. The orders entered December 24, 1987, and December 31, 1987, in this case are vacated.

Justice Scalia took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
